finding.name: Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type
finding.summary: The handler correctly calls http.DetectContentType on the file body and allowlists the result, and generates a random storage base name, but then appends the extension from the client-supplied fileHeader.Filename via filepath.Ext instead of a fixed map keyed by the detected content type, so the client still controls the extension that decides how the stored file is served.
